##### Project general facts

Al Ghadeer Gardens by Aldar is a family-oriented residential neighbourhood of townhouses and villas designed around open green spaces, shaded walkways and a strong sense of community. Restrained, minimalist architecture, pedestrian-first streets and tree-lined avenues give the neighbourhood a calm, welcoming character. Each home rises from a ground floor to a first floor, and the collection includes two- and three-bedroom townhouses and four-bedroom villas, with room for every stage of family life.

Life extends well beyond the front door. A community centre, a swimming pool, a splash pad with a water slide and a general play area create everyday places for families, while a basketball court and a padel court support an active routine. An events lawn, desert stargazing lawns, barbecue pavilions, shaded picnic lawns and landscaped gardens invite neighbours to gather, and a British school within the neighbourhood lets children walk to school along pedestrianised roads.

Interiors are contemporary and practical, with natural materials, spacious layouts and abundant natural light. Open living and dining areas connect with private gardens and terraces, while bedrooms provide calm, comfortable retreats for every member of the family. Smart living features and a self-sufficient environment make everyday life feel effortless. Homes are delivered with fitted kitchens, leaving furniture to the owner's own taste, and planted canopies keep outdoor spaces shaded and green throughout the neighbourhood.

##### Location description and benefits

Al Ghadeer is an established residential community set at the border between Abu Dhabi and Dubai, within the wider Seih Al Sedeirah masterplan. Manicured parks, feature lakes and tree-lined pathways shape a calm, nature-inspired setting, while schools, cafes, retail and community facilities are already in place, giving families everyday essentials close to home and a quieter pace of life away from city traffic.

Al Maktoum International Airport is a short drive away, and Zayed International Airport, Dubai International Airport, Yas Island and the centre of Abu Dhabi are within comfortable driving distance. Sheikh Zayed Road, Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road and Al Fayah Road connect residents with both emirates, while Expo City Dubai and Dubai South are close by for work and leisure.

Al Ghadeer is a freehold community open to international buyers and part of one of the most strategically positioned corridors between the two largest emirates. The expansion of Al Maktoum International Airport and Dubai South continues to strengthen the area's appeal. Accessible entry points for family homes and successive sold-out releases support steady demand and long-term value for owners and investors.
